hypotheses.title: Analyst Quarterly Forecast Skewness Regime with Intraday VWAP Dispersion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures institutional post-earnings announcement drift and revision asymmetry. When the mean quarterly analyst forecast exceeds the median forecast (anl4_adxqfv110_mean > anl4_adxqfv110_median), high-conviction sell-side analysts have aggressively revised projections upwards, creating a positive forecast distribution skew that conservative median consensus has yet to incorporate. Executing via trade_when with a -20 day holding period captures the fundamental drift while dampening turnover. Modulating with rolling intraday VWAP execution dispersion (ts_std_dev(close / vwap, 20)) concentrates capital into equities with active institutional liquidity flows.
confounders: Single outlier analyst providing an extreme erroneous estimate
Protracted macro volatility causing across-the-board earnings guidance downgrades
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if positive forecast skewness reverts into negative guidance revisions without price drift.

candidates.expression: group_neutralize(trade_when(ts_backfill(anl4_adxqfv110_mean, 60) > ts_backfill(anl4_adxqfv110_median, 60), (ts_backfill(anl4_adxqfv110_mean, 60) - ts_backfill(anl4_adxqfv110_median, 60)) / close, -20), currency) * ts_backfill(ts_std_dev(close / vwap, 20), 60)
